description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Regulations made to amend the Industrial Disputes Regulations published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1542/35 of 28.03.2008 by the substitution for Para 2 of the 2nd Schedule
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations under the Industrial Disputes Act, which constitutes legal/regulatory matters. It amends existing regulations regarding fees and payments for arbitrators and members of Industrial Courts, falling under "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation" as defined in Type 5. While it mentions a government minister, it does not focus on government structure/personnel changes but rather on establishing legal regulations.
